newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese cash bonds and futures finish firmer.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese cash bonds and futures finish firmer.

text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures finished a dull session firmer and dealers said Friday would probably be just as quiet.

"At the end of the day prices pushed up slightly in line with Spain," said a trader. Added a dealer, "But tomorrow is the day before a long weekend and it's the end of the month, so it will probably be dead calm."
Portuguese markets will be closed Monday because of a Lisbon holiday for an OSCE summit which is being held in the capital Dec 2 and 3.
The escudo closed steady at 101.00/05 per mark.
